sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Emili.
I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about Cambodia.
Cambodia is a beautiful, historic,
and peaceful country in Southeast Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Are you ready?
Where is Cambodia?
Cambodia is in Southeast Asia.
It is next to Thailand, Laos, and Vietnam.
To the south, it touches the Gulf of Thailand.
It has rivers, lakes, forests, and temples.
What is the capital city of Cambodia?
The capital city is Phnom Penh.
It is the largest city in Cambodia.
It has palaces, markets, museums, and the Mekong River.
Other cities include C.M. Reap near the famous Angkor Wat Temple.
Badum Bang, known for farming and art.
C.N. Okville, a beach city by the sea.
How many people live in Cambodia?
About 17 million people live in Cambodia.
Many people live in the countryside, but cities are growing.
The people are called Cambodians,
and they are known for being kind and welcoming.
What language do people speak in Cambodia?
People speak Khmer, pronounced Khmer.
It is the official language.
Some people also speak English or French
especially in cities and schools.
What is the weather like in Cambodia?
Cambodia has a tropical climate.
It is hot and humid most of the year.
There are two seasons, rainy season from May to October,
dry season from November to April.
The weather is warm all year, so people wear light clothes.
What does Cambodia look like?
Cambodia has the Mekong River, one of the longest in Asia.
Rice fields and palm trees.
Forests, mountains and temples, beaches in the south.
Taunley-Sapp Lake, the largest lake in Southeast Asia.
It is a land of nature, history, and tradition.
What animals live in Cambodia?
In Cambodia, you may see elephants, deer, and monkeys,
crocodiles, snakes, and lizards,
birds like herons and hornbills,
cows, chickens, and ducks and villages.
Some people ride ox carts or keep buffalo for farming.
What do people eat in Cambodia?
Cambodian food is mild, fresh, and delicious.
People eat rice with every meal.
Fish, especially from the lake or river,
vegetables, herbs, and noodles.
Popular dishes, a mock,
fish with coconut and spices and banana leaves,
lock lock, stir-fried beef with sauce,
by sash kruk, rice with grilled pork,
numban chok, rice noodles with curry,
fried insects like crickets or spiders in some places.
What do people drink in Cambodia?
People drink water and coconut water,
iced tea and sugar cane juice,
fruit shakes, mango, banana,
or dragon fruit.
Adults may drink beer or rice wine.
Cold drinks are popular because of the heat.
What is life like in Cambodia?
Life in Cambodia is simple and community-based.
People enjoy spending time with family,
visiting temples, going to markets,
riding motorbikes, celebrating festivals.
Many people work in farming, textiles,
or tourism.
What are some holidays and traditions in Cambodia?
Come here new year in April with water and games.
Peach and Ben to honor ancestors.
Water festival, bottom took,
boat races on the River Independence Day,
November 9th.
Visakh Bocha, Buddhist holiday for Buddha's birth.
Most people in Cambodia are Buddhist
and visit pagodas to pray.
Some fun facts about Cambodia.
The Khmer Empire built Angkor Wat,
the largest temple in the world.
The Cambodian flag is the only flag with a building,
Angkor Wat on it.
Many houses and villages are built on stilts.
Cambodia has one of the youngest populations
in the world.
Traditional music includes gongs,
flutes, and dancing.
Now you know many things about Cambodia.
You know where it is, what people eat,
and how they live.
You learned about temples, nature,
and holidays.
Great job.
Goodbye.
Or as they say in Khmer,
Lehi.
